headline: Private Equity and Venture: 28% of an endowment-style mix, an implied 44% of its risk
takeaway: Why: Gradient assumes Private Equity and Venture Capital carry the mix’s highest volatilities (20.9% and 24.5%), and Private Equity moves closely with developed equity (0.72), so its risk adds to the equity sleeve’s rather than offsetting it. Hedge Funds are 18% of capital but an implied 7% of risk, at 6.8% volatility.
